ratings_why.fun: Every tier has a clear job and the growth curve rises well: Encore bodies win early, Barnstormer and Natrix turn deaths into permanent stats mid-game, and three different Tier 6 capstones give each build somewhere to go.
ratings_why.distinct: Encore and death payoffs read a lot like Battlegrounds Reborn and Deathrattle tribes; the positional Prompter's Boy, Understudy and lobby-wide Notices are the fresh parts.

verdict_why: The curve is good, but Sir Hesketh's mass get-up and recruit-phase Death Scenes have rules gaps that should be written before more tuning.

points.text: Sir Hesketh Hiss says units get back up in their own slot, but that slot may hold a summon or an Understudy that stepped in. Say where they go (nearest empty slot) and what happens when the board is full.
Wreath-Bearer Frog's Encore gift has no duration. Fired in the shop by the Rehearser or Coronella, a player can't tell if it lasts into the next fight or is permanent.

Say whether the Prompter's Boy doubles Death Scenes fired while recruiting. If it does, Rehearser on Dame Natrix in front of it is +2/+2 to the whole board per 3 gold, a strong shop loop worth the owner's eye.
Tier 1-2 are a bit thin on growth: only Bit-Part Lizard grows the board. A Tier 2 buffer that pays on a friendly getting back up would give the Encore start a direction earlier.
Žilvinas reads a game-long total that never falls, so he grows by himself every turn. That fits a payoff; just check the late number in a Bird or Ooze lobby.

standouts.why: A positional multiplier: who stands in front of the Prompter is a real casting choice each turn.
The Brothers Berus turn self-damage into a combo with Encore, a fun lever outside its obvious use.
Old Crest dying last and replaying the whole show is a capstone worth building toward.

weakest.why: Chorus Grass Snake is a plain Reborn body with nothing to draft around later.
The Natterjack's 1 gold on a low bar is filler; it rarely changes a decision.
Toad Claque's in-fight bonus is small and only matters in the Curtain Call build.

flags.note: Old Crest stacks with the Prompter, Encore and Hesketh; with goldens the replays multiply into a dozen-plus Death Scenes a fight.
Smooth Newt Rehearser on Dame Natrix or a Matron in the shop is repeatable permanent value each copy bought, more if the Prompter doubles it.
Žilvinas scales with lobby-wide deaths and never resets; hot in lobbies with Birds and Oozes.
Slot conflicts when units get back up, and ties where both last units die, are not defined.
Duration of the Encore it gives is not stated, which matters when fired while recruiting.
